termsIntro: Publish clear legal terms through immutable versions and deliberate activation.
auditIntro: Inspect the recorded activity, actor and resource using the available audit filters.
staffIntro: Manage staff accounts and roles with SuperAdmin access.
accountIntro: Review your staff account and change your password.
saved: The change was saved and the records were refreshed.
passwordSaved: Your password was changed. Your current session remains active.
uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Check the current records before submitting another change.
conflict: The server rejected this change under the current record or account rules. Review the refreshed records and your inputs.
invalidField: Review {{field}} and enter a valid value.
dateHint: Use a full timestamp with an offset, for example 2026-10-29T09:00:00+02:00.
legalHint: Plain text only. Keep the supplied legal wording in its original language.
immutableTerms: Published versions cannot be edited. Create a new version to change the wording.
activateDescription: Make this the current public terms and deactivate the previous version. The server rejects versions whose effective date is still in the future.
auditBoundary: This audit contract provides actor and resource IDs, action and time. Names and before/after change data are not supplied.
staffRules: The server prevents self-deletion and demotion of your own SuperAdmin account, and protects the last active SuperAdmin. Restore a deleted account before editing it. Account details must be unique.
createStaffDescription: Create this staff account with the selected role. A SuperAdmin can administer other staff accounts.
updateStaffDescription: Save these account details and the selected role. Role changes affect access to staff management. Your identity and the records will be refreshed.
deleteDescription: Soft-delete this staff account and remove its access. The record can be restored later, subject to server account rules.
restoreDescription: Restore this account and its assigned role. The server will check for conflicting account details.
searchStaff: Search staff by name or email
profileBoundary: This account view is read-only. Account details can be updated through SuperAdmin staff management.
passwordBoundary: Use at least 8 characters for the new password. Changing it keeps the current session and does not promise to revoke other sessions.
